# Paretos miss på Hemnet – hör analyschefens om caset i dag

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In the episode the hosts talk with a Pareto analysis chief, called Georg. His main case is Ratos. CEO Gustav Salford has sold off the consumer holdings Plantagen and KVD, which turns Ratos into a cleaner infrastructure and industry investment company. It trades at a low 7x EBITA, and Pareto raised its price target to 49 SEK. Georg also explains why his earlier bullish Hemnet thesis failed: listings leaked to Booli. Pareto has cut Hemnet to hold because a business-model change makes the outlook very uncertain, though he says the stock is more attractive at today's lower levels.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 RATO-B — Ratos | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Pareto (guest analyst) raised the target to 49 SEK. Turnaround after the consumer exits; 7x EBITA with acquisition capacity and room for a re-rating.

#### Reasoning

Guest Pareto analyst: Salford actually delivered the long-promised exit from consumer assets (Plantagen, KVD). What remains grows about 13% in underlying EBITA, with high single digits expected for 2027-28. The stock trades at 7x next year's EBITA, a valuation for a low-quality conglomerate. About 800m SEK in proceeds arrives early next year, and on a strong balance sheet that supports 3.5-5bn SEK of acquisitions, adding 20-25% to EBITA. He wants to capture the inflection from bad to good, with 

#### Sell Triggers

- if underlying EBITA growth falls below high single digits
- if acquisitions are not executed or are of poor quality
- if the valuation re-rates to serial-acquirer multiples

> *"Det man vill fånga är inflektionen nu, att gå från... dåligt till bra. Därför tycker jag det är intressant."*

---

### 🟡 HEM — Hemnet | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Pareto cut it to hold after Q3. The business-model change creates high estimate risk, though the price target is well above the current price.

#### Reasoning

Guest analyst: listings leaking to Booli broke Hemnet's full market coverage, which weakens its pricing power and starts a downward spiral. Hemnet now has to change its business model (scraping agents' listings, free versus paid listings). Until it is clear how many sellers pay versus use free listings, estimate risk is too high. Risk is still very high, but buying at current levels is better than at around 80 SEK after the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if paid listing uptake is weak under the new model
- if continued listing leakage to Booli erodes coverage further

> *"Jag skulle beskriva framtiden som väldigt osäker."*
